value.name: mentions nearby rental rates
value.description: She points out that the rates for the closer place are available to Marcus.
evidence: "The rates for the closer place are here, Marcus," she said

value.name: speaks quietly over sleeping figure
value.description: She lowers her voice so as not to disturb the person breathing under the blanket.
evidence: low enough not to disturb the slow rise and fall under the blanket

value.name: asks which option works
value.description: She asks Marcus which of the available options he wants to choose.

value.name: keeps phone line open
value.description: The call remains connected for a moment after she finishes speaking.
evidence: The line stayed open a beat longer

value.name: hears uneven breathing shift
value.description: She notices Marcus's uneven breathing change slightly on the other end of the line.

value.name: hears swallow before speech
value.description: She hears Marcus swallow before any words come through.
evidence: she heard him swallow before she heard anything that might become a word
